arguments.value: Bruce Howe Hendricks, born in Charleston, South Carolina, in 1957, has served as a United States District Judge for the District of South Carolina since 2014. He was nominated by President Barack Obama and confirmed by the Senate in June 2014 after previously serving as a U.S. Magistrate Judge for the District of South Carolina from 2002 to 2014. Judge Hendricks earned his B.A. from the College of Charleston in 1983 and his J.D. from the University of South Carolina School of Law in 1990. Earlier in his career, he served as an Assistant U.S. Attorney for the District of South Carolina from 1991 to 2002.
